summary: Prepare the unchanged telemetry INSERT statement on fresh asyncpg connections before entering the transaction advisory lock fence, leaving the lock unheld during cold type introspection and codec setup while preserving transactional serialization for insert, sequence allocation, duplicate checks, notification, and acknowledgement.

incident_context.resolution: In build_postgres_write_fn, prepare the unchanged insert_sql (insert_stmt = await conn.prepare(insert_sql)) before opening the transaction and acquiring pg_advisory_xact_lock. Inside the locked transaction, execute insert_stmt.fetch(...) with original batch arrays. This leaves cold codec initialization outside the fence while preserving atomic serialization for execution, sequence assignment, duplicate checks, notification, and commit-before-ACK.
